content:
Ana: Quick heads up — I'm starting the QBR prep thread for AtlasOps (meeting next Wed 10am PT). Need slide owners, updated account health snapshot, and a short list of ask/next steps for execs. Renewal is ~6 weeks out, flagging as yellow risk.
Mike: Can you drop the current health metrics? I'll take the financials + renewals slide.
Ana: Health metrics below — last 30d: uptime 99.91%, avg latency 220ms, user adoption +12% QoQ, support tickets 3 open (1 P2). Net Promoter is 46. I'll add a mini risk blurb.
Jordan: I'll own the ops/infra slide with notes on recent ded pool changes. Do we want to surface the KV cache improvement numbers? good story for cost/perf.
Sam_Onboard: I can do onboarding progress + enablement checklist. Current status: 78% of seats activated, two playbooks pending customer review, enablement webinar scheduled for 4/18.
Lisa: @Ana thanks. From my exec POV we need a one-slide ask: either 12-month renewal at committed level or a pilot for X feature. Also share any customer asks re: Private deploy.
Ana: Noted. Action items I'm capturing: 1) Mike — pricing/renewal options + churn mitigation plan (due Tue). 2) Jordan — infra wins + perf delta slide (due Tue). 3) Sam — enablement completion timeline + recording (due Mon). 4) Ana — compile exec one-pager + rehearsal.
Mike: For renewals, suggest a targeted discount + 3-month ramp credits if they commit to Dedicated. I'll draft two options and expected impact.
Jordan: KV cache improvement numbers: token throughput +18%, per-token cost -9% vs baseline. I'll include graphs. Need product approval for the chart export (cc @Mike).
Ana: Upload slides to this deck by EOD Tue: https://example.com/slides/atlasops-qbr (placeholder). Use the "QBR:AtlasOps" section.
qbr-bot: Reminder: QBR dry run scheduled Mon 3pm PT. Please RSVP with :thumbsup: or :calendar:.
Lisa: I'll join dry run, can we add a 2-min slide for strategic alignment with their CPO? Exec care about roadmap fit.
Sam_Onboard: One ask from CS onboarding call — they want an enablement recording and a short cheat sheet for SREs. I'll draft the cheat sheet and attach before the deck freeze.
Ana: Great. Small feedback capture plan: quick 3-question Google Form after the QBR (adopt / blocker / feature ask). Will send draft.
Mike: FYI flagged renewal risk reason: usage plateau last 2 weeks; investigating whether token quotas or UI confusion. I'll run telemetry filter and report back.
Jordan: If we see plateau, propose a targeted in-product nudge + 1:1 enablement session. Good to have both product and account-level remedies.
Ana: Final notes: keep slides concise (max 12). Exec one-pager must call out renewal ask, risk level, and 2 proposed mitigations. I'll consolidate comments on Tue EOD. Thanks everyone :raised_hands:
Lisa: Thanks team. See you at the dry run.
Mike: I'll post the renewal options doc in this thread when ready.
Sam_Onboard: Adding my checklist to the deck now.
Ana: Closing thread for now — will reopen if blockers pop up.
